name: Toiletocalypse
summary:
This is not just a game about running to the toilet. Toiletocalypse is an absurd roguelike survival where you try to survive a work shift in someone else's apartment before your guts take you down. One shift can be calm. Another turns into chaos you can't control. Everything runs on RNG.

You're paid per job. Finish it, you get paid. Don't, you get nothing. Your guts came to work with you they're the main antagonist. Manage water, pressure, psyche and stamina while you build walls, mop floors, craft drinks and race to the toilet. Runs from 10 minutes to several hours. Early Access.
